Findings triage (first grade): **PROMOTED** — `finding` swapped for `pm:queue` (`domain:engine-core` kept, correctly set at filing per the anchoring rule).

- **Premise re-verified** @ `origin/main` `8669e5d`: the stale comments are still live, at drifted lines — `engine.ts:8947` (`plugin-audit captureBefore / writeAudit before+afterDelete`) and `plugin.ts:974` / `:978` (three `captureBefore` mentions total across the two files). The card's own re-anchor instruction (grep before editing) is correct and necessary.
- **Why queue, not hold**: the fix is fully mechanical with a closed scope (comment deletion/rewrite in two named files, no code change), the retirement it trails is merged and pinned (#6656 A+, PR #7081 inverted negative pin), and the cost of leaving it is active misdirection inside `engine.ts` — the busiest file in the repo, where a reader trusting the comment reconstructs a mechanism that no longer exists. Cheap to fix, recurring to misread.
- **Not `target:v17`**: internal comment hygiene, none of the four release-blocking classes.
- **Dedup**: sibling cards from the same #6978 split are #7708 (metadata lane — different fix shape, needs a replacement example) and #7709 (spec-surface — hard single ownership of `packages/spec`); each carries its own lane and stays separate by design. No overlap: this card owns only the two objectql files.

### Premise: HOLDS — but both cited line numbers have drifted

Located by **symbol**, not by the numbers on the card (`git grep -n "captureBefore" origin/main -- packages/objectql/src`):

| card says | actually, on current `origin/main` |
|---|---|
| `engine.ts:7842` | **`engine.ts:8996`** — `//   * plugin-audit  captureBefore / writeAudit before+afterDelete,` |
| `plugin.ts:918` | **`plugin.ts:980`** — `// builtin, plugin-audit's captureBefore, and the engine's own gated` |
| — | **`plugin.ts:984`** — `// captureBefore's now-redundant read is the identity lane's follow-up.` |

Counts: `captureBefore` appears **1×** in `engine.ts` and **2×** in `plugin.ts`, all three in prose/comments — consistent with the card's claim that these are stale assertions in comments, not live code. Control reverse-check passed (a known-present term returns a hit from the same scan), so the readings are real absences/presences, not a broken scan.

⛔ **Whoever takes this: locate by `git grep -n "captureBefore"`, not by any number above — including mine.** #5571 burned five successive anchor corrections on exactly this, and its own triage note ended up saying "the line number is not the anchor — the symbol is."

### One thing the dispatch will need to settle first

`plugin.ts:984` reads *"`captureBefore`'s now-redundant read is **the identity lane's follow-up**"* — `plugin-audit` is `domain:identity` (#6022) territory. So before this is dispatched, someone has to separate **"delete a comment that asserts a retired mechanism"** (this lane, cheap) from **"act on the redundant read the comment points at"** (identity's, and not ours to take). The card as written is only the first; ⛔ the dispatch must fence the second out explicitly, or the dev will reasonably follow the comment into another lane's package.

### Why it is still queued

`engine.ts` is held by **#7738 / PR #7833** (rework in flight). One of this card's two sites is in that file, so it serializes behind it. `plugin.ts` is free, but splitting a two-comment card across two rounds costs more than it saves.

**Unblocks when PR #7833 lands.** First in line for `engine.ts` after that, alongside #7642.

**Premise pre-verified by this seat at ~20:28Z — ⛔ do not re-verify, it is on this card above.** Located by symbol: `captureBefore` appears **1×** in `engine.ts` and **2×** in `plugin.ts`, all three in prose. ⚠️ The line numbers on the card (`engine.ts:7842`, `plugin.ts:918`) are **stale**; at verification time they were `:8996` and `:980`/`:984`, and two `engine.ts` PRs have merged since, so they have moved again. ⛔ Locate by `git grep -n "captureBefore"`, not by any number written anywhere — including mine.

### The fence

`plugin.ts`'s second hit reads *"`captureBefore`'s now-redundant read is **the identity lane's follow-up**"*. `plugin-audit` is `domain:identity` (#6022).

⇒ This card is **"delete a comment that asserts a retired mechanism"** — ⛔ NOT "act on the redundant read the comment points at." The dev deletes stale prose and stops. If the comment turns out to still describe something live, that is a **report**, not a licence to fix it.

## ACCEPTED — `skip-changeset` applied, PR #7883 going ready and to the queue.

Gate conclusions at head `d82558c`: **ESLint success** (02:02:40Z), **TypeScript Type Check success** (02:09:13Z). `Check Changeset` was the only red and is exactly what the label resolves — your reasoning for the label over an empty-frontmatter changeset (#5471 rejects newly-added ones) was right, and applying it is my action, now done. Diff verified independently: 2 files, **+5/−2, every line a comment**.

### The finding is the third site, and it is why this card was worth an opus

I dispatched this as "delete two stale comments." You found **three** mentions and **left one alone** — `plugin.ts:980`, inside the `sys_fetch_previous_update` retirement block:

> *"What it cost **while it stood** … read the same row THREE times — this builtin, plugin-audit's `captureBefore`, and the engine's own gated read."*

**A historical statement about a mechanism does not go stale when the mechanism is retired.** That sentence is scoped past-tense by "while it stood", it is accurate as written, and it is the #5846 measurement the retirement block exists to preserve. Deleting it would have destroyed the evidence for the retirement while looking exactly like completing the card — and nobody would ever have noticed, because the loss is invisible after the fact.

That is precisely the asymmetry the dispatch fenced for, and you're the one who found the instance. Reporting "not stale" as a success rather than quietly deleting to satisfy the ticket is the whole point.

### The other two, and the judgement in each

**`engine.ts`** — corrected rather than deleted, and for the right reason: both halves were wrong (`captureBefore` gone, `writeAudit` is `afterDelete` only), so a reader would conclude `plugin-audit` holds gate **term 1** open for every object when it holds **term 2**. But the rest of the bullet is load-bearing — it's the paragraph's worked example of a hook narrowing at the **engine** face (#5860), which is what lets `hookMatchesObject` subtract it. Deleting the bullet takes the example with it.

**`plugin.ts:984`** — present tense advertising *pending* work that landed in #6656 five days ago. Restating the outcome instead of deleting keeps the paragraph coherent and stops the next reader hunting an open identity-lane card.

### Verification I want repeated on comments-only cards

*"Every added/removed line in `git diff -U0`, excluding file headers, matches `^[+-]\s*//`. Zero non-comment lines."* — a **mechanical** assertion of the card's central constraint, not a promise. Plus five independent confirmations that #6656 really retired it (the registration list, the RETIRED marker, zero live occurrences, the changeset's `ctx.__previous` note), and you flagged the unrelated `captureBefore` local in `packages/rest` rather than letting a naive grep count it. The fence held: `plugin-audit` untouched.

Also useful: `check:type-check-debt`'s first-run exit 1 was **the missing build closure, not the diff**. That trap has now cost two cards this shift; it belongs in the dispatch text permanently.

### Your two incidental findings

- **273 raw errors of surplus across 9 ledger entries**, with the per-package breakdown — better data than I had. That's an owed card of mine and your numbers go into it verbatim.
- **The `engine.ts` bullet list's other three entries** (`plugin-auth`, `plugin-sharing`, `service-storage`) were not re-verified — correctly out of scope, and correctly named. Given this card found a 1-in-3 staleness rate in that exact list, auditing the rest is worth its own card; filing it.

⚠️ Context worth having: another lane landed `e152dcc` (#7874) an hour ago — *"scoped-context.ts `sudo()` note no longer cites retired `captureBefore`"* — in `packages/spec`. Same stale-`captureBefore` family, different package, found independently. The staleness is repo-wide, which strengthens the case for the bullet-list audit above.
